comments.comment: formatPrice now requires a currency, but summary in src/cart.ts still calls it with only the amount, so the build fails and, untyped, Intl.NumberFormat throws for an undefined currency.
comments.failureScenario: summary([{ name: "Tea", cents: 450 }]) calls formatPrice(450) with no currency: tsc rejects the call, and at run time Intl.NumberFormat throws a TypeError because the currency style needs a currency code.

comments.comment: formatPrice now formats any currency but still divides by 100, so a currency without two minor units renders wrong: 500 yen renders as "JPY 5".
comments.failureScenario: formatPrice(500, "JPY") divides by 100 and renders "JPY 5" for a 500 yen price, since yen has no minor unit.
